data.one_liner: A reactive caching, data-binding, and state management framework with flutter_hooks integration.
data.what_it_does: Hooks Riverpod combines Riverpod state management and dependency injection with flutter_hooks. It handles asynchronous data loading, error states, and caching automatically while making your code testable and modular.
use_when: You are using flutter_hooks in your application and want to use Riverpod for state management.
You need robust caching and automated handling of loading and error states for asynchronous operations.
You want compile-safe dependency injection and testable state.
avoid_when: You prefer the standard Flutter InheritedWidget or Provider without additional state libraries.
You do not use flutter_hooks in your project (use flutter_riverpod instead).
strengths: Builds on Riverpod's powerful caching, auto-dispose, and async state handling.
Compile-safe provider definitions and easy testability.
weaknesses: Tied to the flutter_hooks library ecosystem.
Steeper learning curve compared to simple ValueNotifiers or standard setState.

alternatives.name: flutter_riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want the core Riverpod experience without depending on flutter_hooks.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the classic InheritedWidget-based Provider library.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a strict BLoC and event-driven state management pattern.
